insight: A bootstrapped-then-funded German startup that launched in 2020 and grew into a top European meeting-intelligence player.
name: tl;dv
tagline: AI notetaker that records, transcribes, and summarizes Zoom, Meet, and Teams calls.
description: tl;dv records and transcribes meetings across Zoom, Google Meet, and Microsoft Teams, then generates summaries, action items, and multi-meeting recaps in 30+ languages. It pushes notes into CRMs and tools like HubSpot, Slack, and Notion, and offers an unlimited free tier.
edge: Unlimited free recordings and AI notes across Zoom, Meet and Teams — paid tiers gate CRM/automation, not meeting count.
cons: Advanced AI gated behind paid plans
